question: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) is related with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basic civic amenities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Mission **for **Rejuvenation **and **Urban Transformation **(**AMRUT**) is the **first focused national Water Mission**.
 
• It was **launched **in **June 2015**.
 
• Its **motive **is **to facilitate ease of living to citizens **in **500 cities **by **providing tap connections **and **sewer connections**.
 
• **AMRUT **comes under **Basic Civic amenities**.
 
• The **scope of basic amenities **includes **safe drinking water**, **sanitation**, **housing**, the **all-weather road to the village**, **electrification**, **fuel**, **connectivity**, **healthcare center**, **school**, **playground **and **recreational facilities**, and **many more**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Urban transport is **the **movement of people **within **urban areas using group travel technologies **such as **buses and trains**.
 
• **Urban areas **refer to **modernized places **with a **huge population**. There are **four types of livelihood **prevalent in **urban livelihood**, that is, **street workers**, **factory workers**, **self-employed businessmen**, and **workers **in **organized sectors**.
 
• In **2008**, **IBM began **work on a **'smarter cities' **concept as **part of its Smarter Planet initiative**. By **the beginning of 2009**, the concept had **captivated the imagination **of **various nations **across the globe
